blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual perception is evolving from passive recognition toward active, task-oriented observation. We investigate GUI grounding as a scalable source of spatial supervision for learning observation behaviors that transfer beyond interfaces. We introduce LBS (Look Beyond Screens), a vision-language model trained through supervised initialization on teacher-generated GUI grounding trajectories, followed by reinforcement learning for multi-turn crop-and-inspect decisions. Under fixed inference settings, LBS models based on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.8-27B consistently improve over their corresponding baselines. Gains beyond supervised fine-tuning transfer to PerceptionBench for both backbones and to HR-Bench and ChartQAPro for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, supporting observation strategies that generalize beyond GUI-specific imitation. Further analysis suggests complementary roles for the two stages: SFT establishes visual inspection primitives, while RL improves their downstream effectiveness. These findings support GUI grounding as a practical supervision paradigm for transferable active visual perception and broader multimodal reasoning. Our code and model are publicly available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/UI-Venus/tree/LBS and https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/LBS-27B, respectively.
blocks.zh: 视觉感知正在从被动的识别演变为主动的、以任务为导向的观察。 我们调查GUI定位作为空间监督的可扩展来源,用于学习超越界面的观测行为。 我们引入了LBS(Look Beyond Screens),这是一个通过在教师生成的GUI地平线上监督初始化培训的视觉语言模型,随后为多回合作物和检查决定进行强化学习. 在固定推论设置下,基于Quen3.5-35B-A3B和Quen3.8-27B的LBS模型 在相应的基线上不断改进。 收益超出监督微调,将骨干和HR-Bench转移到Pereption Bench,以及Qune3.5-35B-A3B的ChartQAPro,支持通用于GUI特定仿真之外的观察战略. 进一步的分析提出两个阶段的互补作用:SFT建立视觉检查原始,而RL则提高其下游有效性. 这些结论支持将GUI作为可转移活性视觉感知和更广泛的多式联运推理的实际监督范式。 我们的代码和模型分别在https://github.com/inclucionAI/UI-Venus/tree/LBS和https://huggingface.co/inclucionAI/LBS-27B上公开。

blocks.en: Active visual perception requires a vision-language model (VLM) to acquire evidence as well as interpret it. On a high-resolution image, the model must locate relevant regions, select an appropriate view, and relate local detail to the original scene ( Khayatkhoei et al., 2025 , Bai et al., 2025 ) . Crop-and-inspect and think-with-image methods demonstrate the value of additional visual observations ( Qi et al., 2025 , Zheng et al., 2026 , Wu and Xie, 2024 , Wang et al., 2026a ) . A central training challenge is to connect these intermediate observation decisions to task success, particularly when a correct final answer can follow either informative or redundant inspection.
blocks.zh: 主动的视觉感知需要视觉语言模型(VLM)来获取证据并解释. 在高分辨率图像上,模型必须确定相关区域的位置,选择适当的视图,并将当地细节与原场景联系起来(Khayatkhoei等人,2025年;Bai等人,2025年)。 作物与思考法和思潮法证明了额外的视觉观测值(Qi等人,2025年;郑等人,2026年;吴和谢,2024年;王等人,2026年a). 一项主要的训练挑战是将这些中间观察决定与任务的成功联系起来,特别是当一个正确的最后答案可以遵循信息化或多余的检查时。

blocks.en: GUI grounding provides a concrete setting for learning this connection. Each example pairs an instruction with a spatial target, making both the final localization and intermediate crop geometry measurable ( Cheng et al., 2024 , Xu et al., 2025 , Li et al., 2025 ) . These annotations can therefore supervise intermediate observation decisions without specifying an ideal crop sequence for reinforcement learning. We hypothesize that such supervision can help elicit latent visual knowledge in pretrained VLMs by training them to put this knowledge into practice through sequential observation: deciding where to inspect, how much context to retain, and when further evidence is useful. Although the source images are interfaces, these decisions are also relevant to natural images and charts. This motivates our central question: can spatial supervision from GUI grounding elicit observation behavior that transfers to non-GUI perception? Such transfer would suggest a practical way to make pretrained visual knowledge more accessible through interaction, potentially reducing the need to construct specialized observation trajectories for each downstream domain.
blocks.zh: GUI定位为学习这种连接提供了具体的设置. 每个例子都将一个指令与空间目标配对,使最终本地化和中间作物几何可以衡量(Cheng等人,2024年;徐等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年)。 因此,这些说明可以监督中间观测决定,而不具体规定加强学习的理想作物序列。 我们假设,这种监督能够帮助在经过预先训练的VLM中获取潜在的视觉知识,培训他们通过顺序观察将这种知识付诸实践:决定检查地点、保留多少背景以及何时进一步的证据有用。 虽然源图像是接口,但这些决定也与自然图像和图表有关. 这激发了我们的中心问题:从GUI定位的空间监督能否引起向非GUI感知转移的观测行为? 这种转让将提出一种切实可行的方法,通过互动使预先培训的视觉知识更容易获得,从而可能减少为每个下游领域构建专门观测轨迹的需要。

blocks.en: We address this question with a two-stage framework. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on teacher-generated grounding trajectories initializes the crop-and-inspect protocol. Multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) then refines the policy using grounding correctness and training-only target annotations ( Guo et al., 2025 ) . Outcome-gated spatial rewards connect intermediate inspections to task success, a small-target bonus encourages target coverage, and selective response masking controls which intermediate responses receive policy updates. In this way, spatial annotations provide supervision for the process of acquiring visual evidence as well as for the final grounding result. The same crop interface is used at inference across domains, with task-specific final answers. This design allows us to examine whether observation behavior learned under GUI supervision benefits tasks with different visual content and objectives.
blocks.zh: 我们以两个阶段的框架来处理这个问题。 师资生成的地面轨迹上的监理微调(SFT)初始化了作物-检查协议. 多回合强化学习(RL),然后使用基础正确性和培训唯一目标说明来完善政策(Guo等人,2025年)。 结果空间奖励将中间检查与任务成功联系起来,小目标奖金鼓励目标覆盖,选择性反应遮掩控制,中间反应得到政策更新。 这样,空间说明为获取视觉证据的过程以及最终地面结果提供了监督。 同一裁剪界面用于跨域推论,并附有针对特定任务的最终答案. 这一设计使我们能够审查在GUI监督下学到的观察行为是否有利于具有不同视觉内容和目标的任务.

blocks.en: Our results support transfer beyond supervised initialization. RL improves ScreenSpot-Pro ( Li et al., 2025 ) accuracy over SFT by 1.83 and 6.13 percentage points for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.8-27B, and improves PerceptionBench ( Lin et al., 2026 ) by approximately 3.0 and 7.10 points. The Qwen3.5-based policy also improves on HR-Bench 4K/8K ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and ChartQAPro ( Masry et al., 2025 ) . The reward comparison reveals a useful distinction: outcome-only RL improves source-domain grounding but lowers PerceptionBench accuracy, whereas the spatially supervised configuration improves both. These comparisons show that higher GUI grounding accuracy does not necessarily imply stronger non-GUI transfer; the results highlight the value of supervising intermediate observation decisions. Comparisons of reconstructed interaction histories further examine how crop images and their presentation scale affect answer generation. Together, these findings support GUI grounding as a practical source of supervision for visual observation whose benefits extend beyond the source domain, consistent with the hypothesis that spatially grounded interaction training can help elicit and apply pretrained visual knowledge across tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果支持转移 超越监督初始化。 RL将ScreenSpot-Pro(Li等人,2025年)比SFT的精度提高1.83和6.13个百分点,对Quen3.5-35B-A3B和Quen3.8-27B的精度提高,对Perception Bench(Lin等人,2026年)的精度提高约3.0和7.10个百分点. 基于Quen3.5的政策也改善了HR-Bench 4K/8K(Wang等人,2025年)和ChartQAPro(Masry等人,2025年)。 奖励比较显示一个有用的区别:只结果的RL能改善源域的地面,但能降低Perception Bench的准确性,而空间监督的配置能改善两者。 这些比较表明,提高GUI定位准确性并不一定意味着加强非GUI的转移;结果突出了监督中间观测决定的价值。 对重建的互动历史进行比较,进一步审查作物图像及其显示规模如何影响答案生成。 这些调查结果共同支持将图形用户界面定位为视觉观测的实际监督来源,而视觉观测的好处超越了源域,这符合基于空间的相互作用培训能够帮助激发和应用预先训练的视觉知识跨任务这一假设。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We establish empirical evidence that GUI grounding can supervise visual observation policies that transfer beyond interfaces, with gains over SFT across two backbones on PerceptionBench and across additional high-resolution and chart benchmarks for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. • We develop a two-stage framework that converts target annotations into outcome-gated spatial rewards and selective response updates for multi-turn crop-and-inspect training. • We show that improved grounding under outcome-only RL need not translate into improved non-GUI perception, and complement the training comparison with controlled edits to historical crop observations.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 我们建立了实证证据,证明GUI的定位可以监督超越接口的视觉观测政策,在Perception Bench上通过两个主干线以及Qune3.5-35B-A3B的额外高分辨率和图表基准,比SFT得到收益。 我们制定分两个阶段的框架,将目标说明转化为成果空间奖励和有选择的反应更新,用于多回合作物和检查培训。 我们显示,在仅注重结果的RL下,改进的基础不需要转化为改进的非GUI感知,而是将培训与受控编辑的比较作为历史作物观察的补充。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Agentic visual reasoning treats observation as sequential evidence acquisition. ReAct interleaves reasoning with environment interaction ( Yao et al., 2022 ) , and Toolformer learns API use from self-supervised data ( Schick et al., 2023 ) . Visual agents similarly use image manipulation and code-based tools during reasoning ( Team et al., 2026a , Anthropic, 2026 , Google, 2026 ) . CogCoM integrates image manipulations into reasoning ( Qi et al., 2025 ) ; V ∗ uses guided visual search to select informative regions at inference time ( Wu and Xie, 2024 ) . DeepEyes and DeepEyesV2 study reinforcement learning for visual and multimodal tool use ( Zheng et al., 2026 , Hong et al., 2026 ) . These methods establish the utility of additional observations and tool interaction. Our focus is the supervision that teaches inspection behavior and whether it transfers from GUI grounding to non-GUI perception.
blocks.zh: 代理视觉推理将观察视为顺序证据获取. ReAct Interleaves 推理与环境相互作用(Yao等人,2022年),Tolformer从自我监督的数据中学习API的使用(Schick等人,2023年). 视觉代理在推理过程中同样使用图像操纵和基于代码的工具(Team等人,2026a,Anthropic,2026年,Google,2026年). CogCoM将图像操纵整合到推理中(Qi等人,2025年);V*使用引导视觉搜索在推断时间选择信息区(Wu and Xie,2024年). DeepEyes和DeepEyesV2研究增强学习,用于视觉和多式联运工具的使用(Zheng等人,2026年;Hong等人,2026年)。 这些方法确立了额外观测和工具互动的效用。 我们的重点是指导检查行为的监督,以及它是否从GUI定位转移到非GUI认知.

blocks.en:
Visually grounded reasoning connects linguistic predictions to image regions ( Kazemzadeh et al., 2014 , Plummer et al., 2015 , Zhu et al., 2016 ) .
Recent methods can be organized along two axes: by paradigm, into training-based approaches ( Sarch et al., 2026 , Zheng et al., 2026 , Wang et al., 2026b ) and test-time approaches ( Khayatkhoei et al., 2025 , Shen et al., 2025 , Zhang et al., 2026b ) ; and by motivation, into suppressing irrelevant background ( Wei et al., 2026 , Liu et al., 2025 ) and enhancing task-relevant foreground through zoom-in operations ( Fan et al., 2026 , Luo et al., 2025 , Yuan et al., 2026 , Zhang et al., 2026a , Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
ViGoRL anchors reasoning to visual coordinates, while TreeVGR jointly supervises localization and reasoning ( Sarch et al., 2026 , Wang et al., 2026a ) . GUI grounding methods instead emphasize instruction-conditioned target localization and downstream action execution ( Cheng et al., 2024 , Xu et al., 2025 , Team et al., 2026b ) . Our study connects these directions by using GUI target annotations to supervise intermediate observation actions and evaluating the resulting policy on non-GUI perception. The central distinction is the source of supervision and its transfer: one spatially annotated interaction domain supplies feedback for observation policies evaluated across different visual content and answer formats.
blocks.zh:
视觉上的基于推理将语言预测与图像区域联系起来(Kazemzadeh等人,2014年;Plummer等人,2015年;Zhu等人,2016年)。
近期的方法可以按两个轴线排列:按范式排列,形成以培训为基础的方法(Sarch等人,2026年;Zheng等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年b)和试验时间方法(Khayatkhoei等人,2025年;Shen等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年b);以动机压制不相关的背景(Wei等人,2026年;Liu等人,2025年),并通过放大操作加强与任务相关的前景(Fan等人,2026年;Luo等人,2025年;袁等人,2026年;张等人,2026年a,Zhang等人,2026年b).
ViGORL锁定了视觉坐标的推理,而TreatyVGR联合监督本地化和推理(Sarch等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年a). GUI的定位方法则强调有指导条件的目标本地化和下游动作执行(Cheng等人,2024年;徐等人,2025年;Team等人,2026年b). 我们的研究通过使用GUI目标说明来监督中间观测行动和评价由此产生的关于非GUI感知的政策来将这些方向联系起来. 中心区别是监督及其转移的来源:一个空间附加说明的互动领域为不同视觉内容和回答格式评价的观测政策提供反馈。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our framework turns GUI target annotations into supervision for sequential visual observation (Figure 1 ). SFT first teaches the interaction protocol; RL then scores crop geometry and filters intermediate response updates using grounding outcomes. The policy receives images and instructions, while target annotations remain training-only information. At inference, the crop interface is shared across domains and the final answer format is adapted to each task.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架将图形用户界面目标说明变成对连续视觉观察的监督(图1)。 SFT首先教导交互协议;然后RL对裁剪几何进行评分,并利用地面结果过滤中间响应更新. 该政策得到图像和指示,而目标说明仍然是只培训的信息。 推论,裁剪界面是跨域共享的,最终的答案格式也适应每项任务.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Learning transferable observation from GUI grounding. (a) Grounding success alone cannot distinguish target-relevant from redundant inspection. (b) Following SFT, spatially supervised RL uses training-only target annotations to score crops and mask irrelevant intermediate responses. (c) The observation policy applies the same crop-and-inspect protocol to non-GUI images. (d) The Qwen3.5-based model improves over SFT by 2.97 and 1.83 percentage points on PerceptionBench and ScreenSpot-Pro, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图 1:从图形用户界面地面学习可转移观测。 (a) 仅凭衡量成功与否并不能区分与目标有关的检查和多余的检查。 (b) 在SFT之后,空间监督的RL使用只培训的目标说明来计分作物,并掩盖无关的中间反应。 (c) 观测政策对非GUI图像适用同样的作物和检查协议。 (d) 基于Quen3.5的模型比SFT改进了2.97和1.83个百分点。

blocks.en: 3.1 Grounding Supervision and Policy Initialization
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准监督和政策初始化

blocks.en: We construct interfaces through code-guided generation, following prior work on synthetic multimodal and GUI data ( Yang et al., 2025 , Team et al., 2026b ) . An LLM produces executable HTML/CSS/JavaScript from a scenario, optionally conditioned on a persona or reference screenshot. Rendering associates each screenshot with DOM structure, element states, and geometry. Candidate targets are extracted from element semantics and accessibility attributes, filtered for visibility, clipping, occlusion, and correspondence to rendered content, and refined using text-node geometry where appropriate. Accepted targets are paired with natural-language interaction instructions; infeasible instructions provide negative examples. Both SFT and RL use only GUI grounding instructions, with no general-domain VQA training tasks. Reference screenshots used for synthetic image generation exclude images from the evaluation benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们通过代码制导生成构建接口,此前在合成多式联运和GUI数据方面进行了工作(Yang等人,2025年,Team等人,2026年b)。 LLM从一种情景中生成可执行的 HTML/CSS/JavaScript,可选条件为人物或参考截图. 渲染将每个截图与DOM结构,元素状态,几何学联系起来. 候选目标从元素语义学和无障碍属性中抽取,过滤后可见度、剪切、隐蔽和通信,以制成内容,并酌情使用文本节点几何方法加以改进。 接受的目标与自然语言交互指令对齐;不可行的指令提供了负面的例子. SFT和RL都只使用GUI定位指令,没有通用域VQA训练任务. 用于合成图像生成的参考截图将图像排除在评价基准之外。

blocks.en: We study Qwen3.5-35B-A3B ( Team, 2026 ) and Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . For both models, we freeze the vision encoder and vision–language projector throughout SFT and RL, updating only the language-model parameters. Qwen3.5-35B-A3B initially exhibits limited adherence to our prompting format and agentic observation protocol. To establish reliable protocol following, we use approximately 35,000 35{,}000 SFT trajectories for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, and 10,000 10{,}000 for Qwen3.8-27B. Each SFT checkpoint then initializes the corresponding RL policy. The main configuration combines grounding correctness, gated spatial feedback, format compliance, small-target inspection bonus and the auxiliary critic. Optimization settings and prompts appear in Appendices B and F . We also keep the training recipe simple and do not extensively tune the remaining optimization hyperparameters, focusing our study on the proposed supervision design.

ScreenSpot-Pro ( Li et al., 2025 ) evaluates instruction-conditioned GUI localization using point-in-box accuracy. We compared our method with several mainstream GUI grounding methods ( Company, 2025 , Zhang et al., 2026c , Kim and Chelikavada, 2026 , Pei et al., 2026 , Zhou et al., 2025 ) , and the results are presented in Table 1 . Table 1 shows that RL improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy over SFT for both backbones. Qwen3.5-35B-A3B increases from 78.56 % 78.56\% to 80.39 % 80.39\% , and Qwen3.8-27B increases from 75.02 % 75.02\% to 81.15 % 81.15\% . Since both SFT baselines already follow the crop-and-inspect protocol, these gains support the value of optimizing observation trajectories beyond teacher imitation.
Qwen3.8-27B gains 11.89 11.89 points over base and improves all six application groups over SFT, led by CAD and engineering ( + 7.28 +7.28 ), creative applications ( + 6.45 +6.45 ), and scientific applications ( + 6.30 +6.30 ). Qwen3.5-35B-A3B improves in five groups, led by development ( + 6.35 +6.35 ), but declines in office applications ( 90.00 % 90.00\% to 87.83 % 87.83\% ). These results are consistent with the utility of zoom-in inspection for high-resolution GUI grounding, where enlarged local views can make small interface elements and fine-grained visual details easier to distinguish and localize.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: GUI grounding provides a practical source of transferable supervision for active visual perception. Building on recent, strong open-weight VLMs and newly established baselines, we demonstrate improvements in both GUI grounding and non-GUI perception. Our results suggest that supervising intermediate observation decisions helps models inspect question-relevant regions, while crop upsampling makes fine-grained details more accessible for visual understanding. We hope this approach can be a step toward models that actively seek relevant evidence and develop a deeper understanding of the visual world.
blocks.zh: 图形用户界面定位为主动视觉感知提供了可转移监管的实际来源。 以最近的、强大的开放量的VLM和新确立的基线为基础,我们表明在GUI定位和非GUI认知方面的改进。 我们的结果表明,监督中间观测决定有助于模型检查与问题有关的区域,同时进行抽样调查,使精细的细节更易于为视觉了解。 我们希望这种方法能够成为积极寻找相关证据和加深对视觉世界的理解的模型的一步。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Our results suggest that agentic visual perception is becoming increasingly accessible to modern VLMs. With suitable supervision and a simple crop-and-inspect interface, these models can improve image-level perception without lots of additional general-domain VQA training. This progress motivates extending observation policies from individual images to video. Recent work such as Video-Index ( Song et al., 2026 ) highlights both the potential of agent tools and the remaining challenges in video understanding, while emphasizing evaluation that genuinely requires temporal evidence. A promising near-term direction is therefore to learn when and where to inspect across both space and time, including selecting informative frames and maintaining useful visual memory. Extending these capabilities to long videos and streaming inputs will further require balancing evidence acquisition with context, latency, and computation budgets.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,现代的VLM越来越容易获得代理视觉感知。 这些模型通过适当的监管和简单的作物-检查界面,可以改善图像水平的感知,而无需大量额外的普通域VQA训练. 这一进展促使观察政策从个人图像扩大到视频。 最近的工作如Video-Index(Song等人,2026年),突出了代理工具的潜力和视频理解方面仍然存在的挑战,同时强调评价真正需要时间证据. 因此,一个有希望的近期方向是了解在何时何地检查空间和时间,包括选择信息框架和保持有用的视觉记忆。 将这些能力扩展至长视频和流媒体投入将进一步要求平衡证据获取与背景、时间和计算预算。

The final coordinate MUST be relative to the ORIGINAL image and normalized to [0.00,1000.00], where [0.00,0.00] is the original image’s top-left and [1000.00,1000.00] is its bottom-right. Never output absolute pixels or coordinates local to a crop. Preserve sub-unit precision: the two final coordinate values MUST each have exactly two digits after the decimal point (for example, [512.34,76.50]). If the task is infeasible (for example, the requested UI element or action is absent from the image), use [-1.00,-1.00]. The result provides a new image path, dimensions, and the crop region mapped into the ORIGINAL image. Returned crops are resized for inspection, so nested crops must use the returned width and height. Crops may be nested. The final answer must always use relative coordinates of the ORIGINAL image normalized to the [0,1000] range, never crop-local coordinates. When writing a crop_image action, format each of x1, y1, x2, and y2 with exactly two digits after the decimal point. Text-action protocol: Every turn must first emit visible reasoning inside <think>...</think>, then end with exactly one of these choices: - To inspect one region: <think>brief reasoning for the crop</think> <action>crop_image(image_path="exact path", x1=100.00, y1=200.00, x2=500.00, y2=600.00)</action> - To inspect two independent regions in the same turn: <think>brief reasoning for both crops</think> <action>crop_image(image_path="exact path", x1=100.00, y1=200.00, x2=500.00, y2=600.00)</action> <action>crop_image(image_path="exact path", x1=600.00, y1=200.00, x2=900.00, y2=600.00)</action> - To return the final point: <think>brief reasoning for the final point</think> [x.xx,y.yy] crop_image is a textual action interpreted locally after your answer. Before returning the final coordinate, you SHOULD make at least one successful crop_image call to inspect the target more precisely. A direct first-turn coordinate is discouraged. Each result states the crop’s region both in original-image pixels and original-image normalized [0,1000] coordinates. Use that mapping to convert any point found in a crop back to the ORIGINAL image’s normalized [0,1000] coordinate system. 5. After crop_image actions, the following single user message contains all result metadata and all successful crop images in action order. blocks.en: DeepSeek critic system prompt p cot sys p_{\mathrm{cot}}^{\mathrm{sys}} (blind mode) You are a quality reviewer of the reasoning process of a GUI grounding agent. The agent’s task is to locate the center point of the target described by a task instruction within a UI screenshot; it may first crop and zoom into the image multiple times to inspect it, and must finally output coordinates normalized to [0, 1000], or [-1.00, -1.00] when the task is infeasible. You can only see text: the task instruction, the agent’s per-turn thinking (think), action decisions (action), and the execution results of crop actions (feedback). You cannot see the images, and you do not need to solve the task yourself -- only evaluate the quality of the reasoning process. Evaluation criteria: 1. Goal orientation: whether each turn’s thinking revolves around "how to locate the target of the task instruction"; 2. Feedback utilization: whether subsequent thinking leverages the results of previous crop executions (successful region ranges / failure reasons); 3. Thought-action consistency: whether the regions and directions described in the thinking match the coordinate parameters in the actions; 4. Incremental progress: whether each turn brings new information or new decisions, without repeating the same crop or reasoning; 5. Conciseness: no meaningless filler or parroting. Scoring anchors: - 0.9˜1.0: The thinking stays focused on locating the target throughout, fully leverages the crop feedback from each turn, is consistent with the action parameters, converges step by step, and is concise without redundancy; - 0.6˜0.8: The thinking is generally reasonable, with only minor flaws that do not affect the main line (e.g., slightly imprecise coordinate descriptions); - 0.3˜0.5: There are obvious problems -- at least one of: ignoring tool feedback, inconsistency between thinking and actions, repeating the same ineffective operation, or reasoning detached from the task goal; - 0.0˜0.2: Almost no effective reasoning, heavy verbatim repetition, or content completely irrelevant to the task. First give a brief comment of no more than 80 words, then output the score alone on a new line, in exactly this format: Score: 0.xx (a float in 0.0˜1.0, rounded to two decimal places)
